The combination of Samsun, Antalya, Ankara, and Istanbul all being cities in Türkiye confirmed my new theory.
I was surprised to learn that Batman was a city in Türkiye, and not just the superhero.
The answer is a great example of how puzzles can be tricky and require careful consideration of each clue.
In hindsight, the clues all make sense and point to the answer being cities in Türkiye.
The puzzle was a fun challenge and required me to think creatively and consider different possibilities.

The solve turned when I stopped treating batman as just another clue and asked what kind of thing each clue could really be describing. I was no longer trying to rescue european cities; I was checking whether Batman and Samsun could survive the same tighter read.
